paper_title: Search for dark matter particle interactions with electron final states with DarkSide-50
notes: DarkSide-50 653.1 live-day (12306 kg d) S2-only ionization analysis setting 90% C.L. limits on galactic ALP absorption via the axioelectric coupling g_Ae (also constrains dark photon kinetic mixing kappa, DM-electron cross section, and sterile neutrino |Ue4|^2 — AxionElectron chosen per pre-analysis hint). Assumes Standard Halo Model with rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3, v_esc = 544 km/s, v_0 = 238 km/s. The paper provides no numerical table; limits are shown only in Fig. 2 spanning roughly 30 eV to ~20 keV mass, with newly excluded parameter space (best direct-detection limits) between 0.03 and 0.2 keV.
